hooks.command:
node -e "const p = process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH || ''; const m = p.replace(/\\/g, '/').match(/services/([^/]+)//); if (m) { const fs = require('fs'); const r = 'services/' + m[1] + '/.claude/README.md'; if (fs.existsSync(r)) { console.error('
⚠️  PROCESS REMINDER: Read ' + r + ' before editing this service.
   Use the Read tool on that file first, then proceed.
'); } }"

node -e "const p = process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH || ''; const normalized = p.replace(/\\\\/g, '/'); if (normalized.includes('/services/') && !normalized.includes('/CONTEXT.md') && !normalized.includes('/.claude/') && !normalized.includes('/dist/')) { try { require('child_process').execSync('npm run feedback:check 2>&1 | tail -15', { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: process.cwd() }); } catch(e) {} }"
